integrity: The proof evaluates the primary source's finite-dimensional gap criterion exactly using the three-dimensional free Dirac resolvent, spherical Yukawa integration, antisymmetry of the vector kernel, and a global monotonicity argument. Numerical checks are corroborative only.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to the round sphere and constant scalar matrix coupling in the non-local finite-rank shell model.
No assertion is made about a threshold resonance at \(|\lambda|=\lambda_c\), embedded eigenvalues, scattering, nonspherical shells, or nonconstant matrix coefficients.

Older separable-potential literature may contain an equivalent spherical special case under different terminology; the closest located non-local Dirac source is one-dimensional and is retained as an originality risk.
title: Exact coupling threshold and twofold gap spectral flow for a spherical non-local Dirac shell
